description: Emprise des lignes à haute tension EDF - Ferrières - Ile-de-France is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. The data represents Polygons defining the ground grip of the high voltage line. This data has been digitised as part of the INH end-of-study thesis: DUQUENOY G. Landscape analysis in forest management in peri-urban forests: example in Ferrières Regional Forest, 2005, AEV-INH, 93p. + annexes. (\\mariecurie\www\neo\downloads\2008_11_26_gg_Ferrieres_memoireGD2005.pdf). Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Power takeover of high-voltage lines EDF - Ferrières - Ile-de-France" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include 2005, electricité. The listing shows 2021-10-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
